title: VoltStream Canonical EV Charger Intake Record
description: Eight-field normalized record. Null means the source does not safely support a single value; null must never be replaced by a guess.

station_id.description: Contractor- or operator-supplied stable station identifier; never synthesized.

address.description: Reported physical site address, with harmless whitespace normalization permitted.

charger_level.description: Normalized charging class supported by an explicit source value.

port_count.description: One unambiguous reported count of charging ports. Validation, not the schema, determines whether the integer is physically valid.

power_kw.description: Reported rated power per port in kW. Deterministic unit conversion is allowed.

connector_type.description: Normalized physical connector standard when explicitly supported.

operational_status.description: Normalized reported service state. Use null for absent information; use unknown only when the source explicitly reports an unknown state.

source_record_id.description: Identifier of the contractor submission row or message for lineage; never synthesized.
